timeline.content: Submitted ticket for urgent UC-METC portal token timeout issue.

timeline.author: Alex Reed (Solo IT Lead)
timeline.content: Investigating authentication session expiry in auth_handler.py. Checking Redis session timeout limits for faculty accounts.
